title: Rabbi Acha bar Abba bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.25b.5), speaking in the name of “our master.” Hyman says, “We have already explained” in the entry R' Abba bar Acha that the reading there too should be the same.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The first-person “we have already explained” belongs to Hyman. His cross-reference to the Abba bar Acha entry is retained without assigning a canonical identity target.

The linked Berakhot gives Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Acha bar Abba bar Acha as alternative transmitters, then names Rabbeinu. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=296&lang=en) records the same alternatives. The primary Hebrew says Rabbeinu; the linked English identifies him as Rav.
